verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app backed by a hosted service, so a versioned public API with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only versioning evidence covers desktop release builds (versioned file names and checksums), which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
